user.title: Connect to a TL-AC100 controller
user.description: Connect to the local controller. Setup and polling are read-only. Plain HTTP does not protect credentials or traffic; use a trusted network.

data_description.host: Hostname, IP address, or HTTP(S) origin, optionally including a port. Do not include a URL path.

reconfigure.title: Change the controller address
reconfigure.description: The new address must belong to the same controller.

data_description.host: Hostname, IP address, or HTTP(S) origin, optionally including a port.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate the controller
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current credentials for this controller.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the username and password, or whether another administrator session blocks access.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller.
error.unsupported_device: This device is not a supported TL-AC100 controller.
error.unknown: The controller returned an unsupported response or an unexpected error occurred.

abort.wrong_device: The address belongs to a different controller. The existing configuration has not been changed.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The controller address was updated successfully.

init.title: Controller management
init.description: Monitoring is read-only by default. Enable control only if you want to send explicit management actions. Reboot buttons remain disabled until individually enabled; pressing one interrupts service.

data_description.enable_control: Allow explicit indicator LED and reboot actions. This setting does not run any action by itself.

control_disabled.message: Device control is disabled. Enable it in the integration options before using management actions.

invalid_auth.message: Controller authentication failed. Reauthenticate the integration.

control_failed.message: The controller could not complete the action. Check the device state before trying again.

control_unavailable.message: The device is offline or is not managed by this controller.
